questions.question: Elixir nima?
options: Erlang VM (BEAM) da ishlaydigan funksional, concurrent dasturlash tili

questions.question: Elixir da IO.puts nima qiladi?
options: Konsolga matn chiqaradi va yangi qator qo'shadi

questions.question: Elixir da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Elixir da list nima?
options: Linked list — [1, 2, 3], head | tail pattern bilan

questions.question: Elixir da pattern matching nima?
options: = operatori orqali chap va o'ng tomonni moslashtirish — {:ok, val} = result

questions.question: Elixir da defp nima farq qiladi?
options: Private funksiya — faqat modul ichida kirish mumkin

questions.question: Elixir da |> (pipe) operator nima qiladi?
options: Chap qiymatni o'ng funksiyaning birinchi argumentiga uzatadi — zanjir hosil qilish

questions.question: Elixir da defmodule nima uchun?
options: Modul e'lon qilish — kodni tashkil qilish birlig

questions.question: Elixir da immutability nima?
options: Barcha ma'lumotlar o'zgarmas — yangi qiymat yangi o'zgaruvchi

questions.question: Elixir da process nima?
options: BEAM virtual machine lightweight process — juda arzon, millionlab bo'lishi mumkin

questions.question: Elixir da send va receive nima uchun?
options: Processlar o'rtasida message passing — send(pid, message)

questions.question: Elixir da GenServer nima?
options: OTP — stateful server process — init, handle_call, handle_cast, handle_info

questions.question: Elixir da Supervisor nima?
options: Process monitoring — ishlamay qolgan processlarni qayta ishga tushirish

questions.question: Elixir da OTP nima?
options: Open Telecom Platform — fault-tolerant tizimlar uchun Erlang/Elixir framework

questions.question: Elixir da Agent nima?
options: Oddiy stateful process — GenServer dan sodda, bitta qiymat saqlash uchun

questions.question: Elixir da protocol nima?
options: Polimorfizm mexanizmi — turli tiplar uchun implementatsiya

questions.question: Elixir da behaviour nima?
options: Callback funksiyalar to'plami — GenServer, Supervisor kabi

questions.question: Elixir da use nima uchun?
options: Modul funksionalligini import qilish va __using__ macro ni ishga tushirish

questions.question: Elixir da macro nima?
options: Kompilyatsiya vaqtida kodni kengaytirish — quote va unquote bilan AST manipulyatsiya

questions.question: Elixir da ETS (Erlang Term Storage) nima?
options: In-memory table — tez, concurrent, process dan mustaqil xotira

questions.question: Elixir da Ecto nima?
options: Database wrapper va query language — changeset, repo, migration

questions.question: Elixir da Phoenix nima?
options: Yuksak ishlash quvvatiga ega web framework — LiveView, channels bilan

questions.question: Elixir da with nima uchun?
options: Bir nechta pattern match zanjiri — muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa error qaytaradi

questions.question: Elixir da Stream nima?
options: Lazy enumerable — katta ma'lumotlar uchun xotirani tejash

questions.question: Elixir da for comprehension nima?
options: for x <- list, condition, do: expression — filtering va mapping birgalikda

questions.question: Elixir da String.split nima qiladi?
options: Stringni delimiter bo'yicha list ga bo'ladi

questions.question: Elixir da Kernel.inspect nima qiladi?
options: Har qanday qiymatni debug uchun string representatsiyaga aylantiradi

questions.question: Elixir da Let it crash philosophy nima?
options: Xatoliklarni tuzatish o'rniga process o'lib Supervisor qayta tiklashiga ruxsat berish

questions.question: Elixir da hot code reload nima?
options: Tizimni to'xtatmasdan yangi kod versiyasini ishga tushirish — BEAM qo'llab-quvvatlaydi

questions.question: Elixir da distributed computing qanday?
options: Node larni bir-biriga ulash — Node.connect, :rpc, pg — bir nechta serverlarda process

questions.question: Elixir da DynamicSupervisor nima?
options: Runtime da bola processlarni dinamik yaratish va boshqarish

questions.question: Elixir da Registry nima uchun?
options: Process larni nom bilan ro'yxatdan o'tkazish va topish — global, local

questions.question: Elixir da LiveView nima?
options: Server-side real-time UI — WebSocket orqali, JavaScript minimal

questions.question: Elixir da quote va unquote nima uchun?
options: Macro da AST bilan ishlash — quote — AST yaratish, unquote — qiymat qo'yish

questions.question: Elixir da GenStage nima?
options: Back-pressure bilan producer-consumer pipeline — data processing

questions.question: Elixir da Broadway nima?
options: Concurrent, multi-stage data ingestion framework — GenStage asosida

questions.question: Elixir da Nx (Numerical Elixir) nima?
options: Tensor va numerical computing kutubxonasi — ML uchun

questions.question: Elixir da ETS vs DETS farqi?
options: ETS — in-memory (tez); DETS — disk asosida (persistent, lekin sekin)

questions.question: Elixir da Mnesia nima?
options: Erlang distributed in-memory/disk database — ACID, replication

questions.question: Elixir da sigil nima?
options: ~r, ~s, ~w kabi maxsus literal — custom sigil ham yaratish mumkin

questions.question: Elixir da mix nima uchun?
options: Elixir build tool — loyiha yaratish, test, compile, dependency boshqarish

questions.question: Elixir da Telemetry nima uchun?
options: Metrics va monitoring uchun event-based kutubxona — attach handlers
